description: This file defines the SelfEvaluationController class for managing self-evaluation views in the OrangeHRM Performance plugin. It handles pre-render logic to set up performance review components and capability checks based on user roles and review data.

classes.name: SelfEvaluationController
classes.description: Controller class managing self-evaluation interface for performance reviews, extending AdminEvaluationController and utilizing traits for performance review services and user role management.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the performance review component for rendering by fetching review data based on 'id' parameter, and sets it in the component. Throws exception if 'id' is missing.

methods.name: isCapable
methods.description: Checks whether the current user has permission to access the review specified by 'id', considering if the review exists and if the employee is not purged, then verifies if the user is the self-employee.
